modules.title: AI 写进攻略的开放时间怎样被核验
旅行攻略里的事实怎样核验

items.title: 模型会生成，不会天然取证
items.text: 模型擅长根据模式组织语言，却可能在缺少上下文、资料过期或问题没有唯一答案时补出貌似合理的细节。

items.title: 联网调研要落到一手信源
items.text: 遇到开放时间、政策或价格等会变化的外部事实，可以让 Agent 联网调研；但要打开官网、官方公告或原始文件，核对发布日期、适用对象和多个来源是否一致。只有搜索摘要或二手转载时，结论仍应标为不确定。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: AI 幻觉不等于每个错误都来自 AI，也不等于联网后必然正确。工具和检索结果仍可能过期、无关或被误读；高风险决定需要检查原始来源和适用范围。

lessonPractice.title: AI 说“城市博物馆周一开放到 22:00”，还把它排进了晚间行程。哪种做法最合适？

options.label: 联网查看博物馆官网、官方预约页和当天场次，核对日期后再决定是否保留这项行程
options.feedback: 对。开放时间可以从带日期的一手来源直接核验，搜索摘要和 AI 的详细描述都不能替代官方信息。

options.label: 攻略写得很具体，还有具体时间，所以直接照着去
options.feedback: 具体时间让说法更像真的，却不能证明它准确；到现场才发现闭馆会直接打乱行程。

options.label: 继续问同一个 AI 它是否确定，不查看其他来源
options.feedback: 同一模型重复确认不是独立证据，应回到官网、官方预约页或场馆公告。

en.title: AI says the city museum is open until 10 PM on Monday and puts it in the evening itinerary. What is the best action?

options.label: Research the museum's official website, official reservation page, and daily sessions online, then check the date before keeping it in the itinerary
options.feedback: Correct. Dated primary sources can verify opening hours directly; a search summary or detailed AI wording cannot replace official information.

options.label: Follow the guide because it includes a specific time
options.feedback: A precise time makes the claim sound real but does not prove accuracy. Arriving to find it closed would disrupt the trip.

options.label: Keep asking the same AI if it is sure without checking another source
options.feedback: Repeated confirmation from the same model is not independent evidence. Return to the official site, official reservation page, or venue notice.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这份 AI 旅行攻略要给家人使用。请联网逐项核对景点开放时间和预约要求，优先查看官网、官方公告或官方预约页，并附上来源链接、发布日期或更新时间。只有搜索摘要、二手转载或找不到原始来源的内容，先标为不确定，不要补造链接。核对后删掉闭馆或无法预约的安排。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: My family will use this AI-generated travel guide. Research every venue's opening hours and reservation rules online, prioritizing official websites, announcements, or reservation pages. Include the source link and publication or update date. Mark claims supported only by search summaries, secondary reposts, or no original source as uncertain, and do not invent links. Remove closed or unavailable visits after checking.

references.title: 为什么语言模型会产生幻觉

learning.assumes: You have seen AI provide a complete guide, explanation, or answer with no source.
learning.outcome: You can decide when online research is needed and find verifiable primary sources for facts that affect a real plan.

modules.title: How an opening time in an AI guide gets verified
How to verify facts in a travel guide

items.title: A model generates; it does not inherently collect evidence
items.text: A model is good at organizing language from patterns, but can fill gaps with plausible details when context is missing, material is outdated, or no single answer exists.

items.title: Online research must lead to primary sources
items.text: For changing external facts such as opening hours, policies, or prices, an Agent can research online. Open the official site, announcement, or original file, then check publication date, applicability, and whether independent sources agree. A search summary or secondary repost alone leaves the claim uncertain.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: An AI hallucination is not the source of every mistake, and connecting to the web does not guarantee correctness. Tool and search results can still be outdated, irrelevant, or misread; high-stakes decisions require original sources and applicability checks.
